description: [Ncloud Storage] Copy an object within Ncloud Storage (PUT /{key} with x-amz-copy-source). Optionally change the storage class (STANDARD (default): Standard Class | ONEZONE_IA: One Zone-IA (Infrequent Access) Class | DEEP_ARCHIVE: Archive Class) — copying an object onto itself with a new class is how an existing object's class is changed. Source objects up to 5 GB; larger ones need ncloud_ncs_upload_part_copy. A DEEP_ARCHIVE source must be restored first.

contentType.description: Content-Type for the copy (applied with metadataDirective=REPLACE)

copySource.description: Source object as {sourceBucket}/{sourceKey} (a leading slash is tolerated)

copySourceIfMatch.description: x-amz-copy-source-if-match — copy only if the source ETag equals this value

copySourceIfModifiedSince.description: x-amz-copy-source-if-modified-since — date of the source object (ISO 8601 or HTTP-date; sent as HTTP-date)

copySourceIfNoneMatch.description: x-amz-copy-source-if-none-match — copy only if the source ETag differs from this value

copySourceIfUnmodifiedSince.description: x-amz-copy-source-if-unmodified-since — date of the source object (ISO 8601 or HTTP-date; sent as HTTP-date)

copySourceVersionId.description: Version ID of the source object to copy (versioning-enabled buckets)

expectedBucketOwner.description: x-amz-expected-bucket-owner — expected owner account number of the bucket: the account number inside any resource NRN (nrn:PUB:<service>:<region>:<accountNo>:…, e.g. from ncloud_resource_list_resources). The 36-char owner ID from ncloud_ncs_list_buckets is rejected as InvalidBucketOwnerAWSAccountID. A different owner is rejected with AccessDenied (403)

ifMatch.description: If-Match — write only if the current object's ETag equals this value (quotes optional). '*' is not supported. Cannot be combined with ifNoneMatch. Fails with 412 PreconditionFailed otherwise

ifNoneMatch.description: If-None-Match — only '*': write only if no object with this key exists (create-only). Cannot be combined with ifMatch. Fails with 412 PreconditionFailed if the key exists

metadataDirective.description: COPY (default) keeps the source metadata; REPLACE uses the headers given in this request (contentType)

objectLockLegalHold.description: x-amz-object-lock-legal-hold for the copy — ON | OFF

serverSideEncryption.description: x-amz-server-side-encryption for the copy — AES256 | aws:kms

sourceExpectedBucketOwner.description: x-amz-source-expected-bucket-owner — expected owner account number of the bucket: the account number inside any resource NRN (nrn:PUB:<service>:<region>:<accountNo>:…, e.g. from ncloud_resource_list_resources). The 36-char owner ID from ncloud_ncs_list_buckets is rejected as InvalidBucketOwnerAWSAccountID. A different owner is rejected with AccessDenied (403)

storageClass.description: x-amz-storage-class for the copy — STANDARD (default): Standard Class | ONEZONE_IA: One Zone-IA (Infrequent Access) Class | DEEP_ARCHIVE: Archive Class. Omit to use STANDARD

name: ncloud_ncs_copy_object
